mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of prenatal fitness training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prenatal fitness training helps maintain strength, flexibility, and cardiovascular health during pregnancy, which can alleviate common discomforts like back pain and fatigue. It also prepares your body for labor and postpartum recovery. A key benefit of functional fitness, like that offered at Cave Training, is its focus on movements relevant to daily life, ensuring exercises directly support the physical demands of pregnancy and new motherhood, helping you build practical strength.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prenatal fitness offers benefits like reduced discomfort, improved labor preparation, and faster postpartum recovery. Functional fitness specifically aids in building practical strength for daily pregnancy demands.
